compiled_state.title: Update project docs to reflect the unified per-branch CI review architecture
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update CI-INTEGRATION.md to describe the unified per-branch CI review flow for ci-pr mode. Update sprint SKILL.md phase definitions table for accuracy. Confirm INSTALL.md Ruleset documentation completeness (S3 owns setup instructions; this story defers to S3's scope and handles non-Ruleset CI-INTEGRATION.md content).

**Why**: After the architecture refactors land (S1–S8), CI-INTEGRATION.md and related docs will be stale. Operators and contributors reading these docs need accurate descriptions of the session→main PR as sole merge path, per-branch-review.yml as the sub-branch gate, and the provenance verifier as the integration review pre-step.

**Scope**:
- IN: CI-INTEGRATION.md: describe unified per-branch CI review flow (session→main PR as sole path; per-branch-review.yml for sub-branches; provenance verifier; narrow integration review scope); sprint SKILL.md Phase A/F definitions table accuracy; do NOT duplicate INSTALL.md Ruleset setup content (that is S3's done definition)
- OUT: INSTALL.md Ruleset setup section (owned by S3); any new documentation files; CLAUDE.md edits (must go through doc-writer via CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report if warranted)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CI-INTEGRATION.md accurately describes the unified per-branch CI review architecture: session→main as sole merge path, per-branch-review.yml as sub-branch CI gate, provenance verifier as integration review pre-step, narrow integration scope definition
  ← Satisfies: documentation completeness for the new architecture
- When this story is complete, no doc content in this story's edits duplicates INSTALL.md Ruleset setup sections (those remain in S3's scope)
  ← Satisfies: scope delineation
- When this story is complete, the DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block is included in the completion report and any CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE reports are surfaced to the user before the story closes
  ← Satisfies: doc-router compliance

## Considerations

- [Scope] S3 already owns INSTALL.md Ruleset setup documentation as a hard done definition. This story must explicitly defer INSTALL.md Ruleset sections to S3 and limit its INSTALL.md edits to non-Ruleset content. If S3's INSTALL.md done definition already covers all needed Ruleset content, this story does not need to touch INSTALL.md at all.
- [Maintainability] Apply doc-router.md gates before writing: Gate 1 (skill-scoped changes → SKILL.md), Gate 2 (extends reference doc → CI-INTEGRATION.md), Gate 5 (CLAUDE.md only via CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report).

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
